articles.title: A Wild Thanksgiving: Storms, Power Outages and a Parade Moved to Saturday
articles.summary: A huge Thanksgiving storm knocked out power for nearly a million people, delayed travel and flooded coastal areas — and pushed the 100th Macy's parade to Saturday.

articles.title: The Supreme Court Will Decide on Asylum at the Border
articles.summary: The Supreme Court will soon decide whether the president can stop asylum at the southern border on his own.

articles.title: Can We Trust AI Too Much? A Robot Expert Has Questions
articles.summary: Robotics expert Dr. Ayanna Howard says we often trust AI too much — and kids need to learn to use it wisely.
